title: Philippians Bible Quiz - Chapter 2
description: Ten questions on Philippians 2: counting others better than yourself, Christ who emptied himself, and the sending of Timothy and Epaphroditus.

questions.text: How does verse 2 say they can make his joy full?
questions.explanation: Verse 2 asks them to make his joy full by being like-minded, having the same love, being of one accord, of one mind.

answers.text: By being like-minded, having the same love, of one accord and of one mind
By sending him help for his need while he is in bonds
By keeping the feast with one another in his absence
By choosing new overseers and servants among them

questions.text: In humility, how is each one to count others?
questions.explanation: Verse 3 says to do nothing through rivalry or conceit, but in humility each is to count others better than himself.

questions.text: What form did he take when he emptied himself?
questions.explanation: Verse 7 says he emptied himself, taking the form of a servant, being made in the likeness of men.

questions.text: To what point did he become obedient?
questions.explanation: Verse 8 says that being found in human form, he humbled himself, becoming obedient to the point of death, yes, the death of the cross.

answers.text: To the point of hunger in the wilderness
To the point of leaving his own city
To the point of silence before his accusers
To the point of death, the death of the cross

questions.text: What did God give him when God highly exalted him?
questions.explanation: Verse 9 says God highly exalted him and gave to him the name which is above every name.

answers.text: The name which is above every name

questions.explanation: Verse 11 says every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.

answers.text: That the Father has sent his Son
That salvation is of the Jews

questions.text: How are they to do all things, according to verse 14?
questions.explanation: Verse 14 says "Do all things without complaining and arguing."

questions.text: How does verse 15 say they are seen in the middle of a crooked and perverse generation?
questions.explanation: Verse 15 says that among them they are seen as lights in the world.

answers.text: As strangers in a foreign land
As salt scattered on the earth

questions.text: Whom does he hope to send to them soon, so that he may be cheered up by news of them?
questions.explanation: Verses 19 and 20 say he hopes in the Lord Jesus to send Timothy to them soon, and that he has no one else like-minded who will truly care about them.

questions.text: Why are they to hold Epaphroditus in honor?
questions.explanation: Verses 29 and 30 tell them to receive him with all joy and hold such people in honor, because for the work of Christ he came near to death, risking his life to supply what was lacking in their service toward him.

answers.text: Because he was appointed an overseer at Philippi
Because he carried this letter to them from Macedonia
Because he had been a fellow prisoner with him
Because for the work of Christ he came near to death, risking his life
